arguments.content: General review pattern illustrated by a synthetic reporting checkpoint, not a live project or production observation: at a provider boundary, transport/operation acceptance and applied-state confirmation can be distinct. Mapping a provider's ok flag directly to a settings-save success result can silently violate a contract requiring requested values to be applied. Retain the authoritative applied-state check and cover accepted-but-not-applied responses with a regression test. The supplied independent reviewer rated the synthetic example P1; the external reviewer failed before reading any source, so this pattern has no external corroboration. No runtime tests or deployed revision were supplied.
